name: The Ritz Carlton Dubai
positioning: Beachfront resort at JBR in Dubai, officially The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai, on a private beach and designed after low-rise Mediterranean buildings
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach steps from The Walk at JBR

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Arabian Gulf.
Blue Jade serves the cuisines of Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, Japan and China.
Splendido is an Italian restaurant with a marble bar and a Tuscan-inspired terrace and piazza.
La Baie has a swim-up bar and luxury cabanas.
Access to the Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge requires an upgraded Club booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not include it.
Ritz Kids is for children aged 4 to 12 and offers daily activities and a dedicated playroom.
On-site activities include water sports, archery, volleyball, tennis and yoga.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa services and facilities are for guests 18 years of age or older.
The hotel is listed with a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star award for 2026.
Condé Nast Traveler describes rose macarons served on arrival and geometric Islamic carvings on the room window screens.

highlights.text: The hotel sits on a private beach, steps from The Walk at JBR.
The resort was designed to emulate the low-rise buildings of the Mediterranean.
The Arabia Felix spa journey uses Dead Sea salt, sands from the Emirates and camel milk.
The resort grows herbs, microgreens and lettuce at an on-site hydroponic facility a few steps from the kitchen.
Tamoka is a beachfront restaurant serving Antillean flavors.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
Dubai International Airport is approximately 35 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes a busy beachfront location in a popular tourist area.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai
